The carrier must accept the declaration for it to take effect. For an accepted declared value, compensation for proven physical loss or damage will not exceed the lesser of the documented loss and the accepted declared value, subject to a maximum of USD 8,000 per shipment. source_page_content:
Declared Value and Liability

Section 6.4 — Declared Value for Carriage

The shipper must state the requested value for carriage in the booking record before tendering the cargo and pay the applicable declared-value charge. The carrier must accept the declaration for it to take effect.

Section 6.5 — Maximum Compensation

For an accepted declared value, compensation for proven physical loss or damage will not exceed the lesser of the documented loss and the accepted declared value, subject to a maximum of USD 8,000 per shipment. If no declared value is accepted, compensation will not exceed USD 20 per kilogram, up to USD 1,500 per shipment. These limits do not establish compensation where no physical loss or damage is proven.
declaration_requirement: The shipper must state the requested value in the booking record before tendering the cargo, pay the applicable declared-value charge, and obtain carrier acceptance for the declaration to take effect.
